subject: Re: Sunday hike
text: Yes. Still on. Weather looks rough. Shoes matter. Bring boots. Trail may be muddy. I checked last week. It was soft. No one wants wet socks. Meet at my place. 8:30. Not 9. I have coffee. You bring snacks. Two people can carpool. I texted both. One will also carry water. Another has the map. I will bring rope. I worry about the loose ladder near the ridge. We should not go there. Stick to signs. If rain gets heavy, we turn. Safe walk beats brave walk. Call if late. Battery low? Charge phone. I live nearby. Door open.
